about:
Plastic Molding Manufacturing, doing business as True Precision Plastics, a division of ResTech Plastics, LLC, is based in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

It provides custom injection molding for both thick- and thin-wall parts, along with secondary processes such as assembly, CNC machining, coatings (including chrome), and vibration welding. The firm notes that it is one of only two processors on the East Coast offering vibration welding. Value-added services are handled in-house or through qualified suppliers.

The company does not publicly list specific industries served, focusing instead on a broad range of industrial customers requiring molded components and secondary operations.

True Precision Plastics holds ISO 9001 certification and emphasizes its vibration welding capability and consolidated in-house value-added services as key differentiators for customers seeking streamlined manufacturing support.
